text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the feeding difficulties in more detail, such as whether he vomits after eating or has trouble swallowing? Also, has he had any episodes of bloody stools or failure to gain weight?

text: Does the baby have a fever, and have you noticed any mucus or blood in his stools? I need to assess for signs of inflammation or infection.

text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the baby pass stool regularly, and if so, is it large and foul-smelling? Have you noticed any signs of abdominal distension since birth?

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the baby passed any meconium since birth, and did he pass it within the first 48 hours? Also, has there been any bilious vomiting or abdominal X-rays performed yet?
